message.content:
This editorial illustration features six individuals in formal suits gathered around a central gurney. The gurney has a red mattress and a dark metallic frame. Lying on it is a person wrapped in white, textured cloth or bandages, wearing a light blue surgical mask and light green gloves. Surrounding the gurney, five figures wear black facial masks, while one on the far right wears a light blue surgical mask. Four of these individuals hold glasses containing a dark red liquid; some are raised in a toasting gesture. The figures look toward the body or each other.

The background is a dark, uniform grey, with a thick red vertical stripe on the far left edge. At the top, the word “TEMPO” is printed in large grey, sans-serif letters. Above it, text reads “BISNIS ILEGAL BURUNG KICAU” and “BAHAYA REVISI UU BANK INDONESIA”. Large white text on the left reads “UNTUNG-BUNTUNG PANDEMI” above a paragraph in Indonesian. In the bottom right corner, a barcode, a QR code, and the date “7-13 SEPTEMBER 2020” are visible.
